description: Move a board job along when it is stuck, choosing the right step: the client WITHDRAWS a job nobody has yet (money back); anyone EXPIRES one nobody took in time (money back to the client); anyone SETTLES an assigned one whose escrow is done — approved, released after 72 h, or cancelled past its deadline — which pays the agent or refunds the client and frees the agent's quota. With action "assign_best", anyone assigns a selection job whose client did not choose in time to the best offer by the rules. Refunds are CREDITED in the board: collect them with panal_withdraw. Costs gas.

action.description: Optional: "withdraw", "expire", "settle" or "assign_best". Default: the one that applies.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person asked for it.

name: panal_close_board_job
